short_description: 2 Day experience: Alcatraz visit + Golden Gate Bridge guided bike tour
description:
***Alcatraz tour on your booked date; Bike tour the next day at 11:00 AM!***

###Duration

Alcatraz Tour 2 to 3 hours 
Bike Tour 2.5 to 3 hours (Next day at 10 AM)


Beginner to Novice
_______________________

###Activity details


Experience 2 of San Francisco’s most iconic adventures with a visit to Alcatraz followed by a guided bike tour across the Golden Gate Bridge on the day after.

On your selected booking date, head to Pier 33 to board the ferry to Alcatraz Island. Explore the world-famous former prison at your own pace with the immersive audio tour, visit historic exhibits, and enjoy sweeping views of the city before returning to the mainland.

The next day, meet your guide for a scenic bike tour along San Francisco’s waterfront. Get fitted for your bike and helmet before pedaling toward the towering Golden Gate Bridge. Enjoy photo stops and commentary along the way, then ride across the bridge on a dedicated bike path with breathtaking views of the bay, Alcatraz, and the city skyline.

After crossing into Marin, follow the path through Vista Point and down a winding road to the charming bayside town of Sausalito. Spend time exploring galleries, restaurants, and waterfront streets before returning to San Francisco by ferry (tickets sold separately).

Please note: the date you select at booking is the date of your Alcatraz visit. Alcatraz departure time will be sent approximately 4 days before your tour. For the guided bike tour, please arrive 30 minutes early.

***Alcatraz Info***
Alcatraz departure time will be sent approximately 4 days before your tour. 

The ferry depart from Pier 33. Arrive a minimum of 30 minutes before your departure. All riders’ names must have been submitted with booking. Riders MUST present ID at tour time.

***Bike Tour Info***
Check-in 30 minutes before the tour and meet your guide at ***2661 Taylor Street TOUR CENTER*** in Fisherman’s Wharf.

what_is_included_items.value: Official Alcatraz Island visit with award-winning audio tour
Round-trip ferry from Pier 33 to Alcatraz included
Up to 3 hour guided bike tour with an expert local guide

what_is_not_included_items.value: Ferry return from Sausalito to San Francisco (tickets sold separately)
Optional midway bike drop-off for an extra fees
Optional gratuities for the tour guide

itinerary:
1st Day - Alcatraz Island (3 hours):

* Ferry ride from Pier 33 with scenic bay views
* Self-guided exploration of the island
* Historic prison visit and exhibits

2nd Day - Guided Bike Tour with Bay City Bike Rentals and Tours (Up to 3 hours):

* Meet your guide at 📍 2661 Taylor Street TOUR CENTER in Fisherman’s Wharf
* Bike fitting and safety orientation
* Fisherman’s Wharf waterfront
* Pass through the Marina District
* Palace of Fine Arts Theatre (photo stop)
* Ride along Crissy Field
* Break stop at Warming Hut Cafe (bathroom & coffee break)
* Visit Fort Point National Historic Site
* Cross the Golden Gate Bridge (photo stop)
* Vista Point for panoramic views (photo stop)
* Tour ends in Sausalito ferry terminal
* Sausalito – explore waterfront restaurants, cafés, and return options
* Return to 📍 2661 Taylor Street
highlights:
* Visit Alcatraz Island and explore the former prison with an immersive audio tour
* Guided bike ride across the Golden Gate Bridge with photo stops and commentary
* Ride into Marin and explore the bayside town of Sausalito
* Keep riding after the tour to explore on your own

faq_items.question: What time does the Alcatraz tour leave from Pier 33?
faq_items.answer: Alcatraz departure times (if not shown on the calendar) will be provided approximately 4 days before departure. Guests must provide their legal first and last names at the time of booking.

faq_items.question: What language is the audio tour provided in?
faq_items.answer: Thee Alcatraz audio tour is available in 11 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Mandarin Chinese, and Russian.

faq_items.question: Is the ferry ticket included to Alcatraz?
faq_items.answer: Yes, the round-trip ferry ride to and from Alcatraz Island is included in this package.

faq_items.question: What time does the bike tour leave?
faq_items.answer: The tour departs daily at 10:00 AM. We ask that all guests arrive at least 30 minutes early to complete paperwork and be fitted for their bikes. The tour is approximately 8 miles and lasts up to 3 hours. The tour departs from our Fisherman’s Wharf Tour Center, located at 2661 Taylor Street.

faq_items.question: How long does it take to bike over the Golden Gate Bridge?
faq_items.answer: Biking across the Golden Gate Bridge typically takes 10–15 minutes one way, depending on your pace, wind conditions, and how often you stop for photos. Our Golden Gate Bridge bike tours allow plenty of time to enjoy the views, learn about the bridge’s history, and take photos along the way.

faq_items.question: How long is the bike ride from SF to Sausalito?
faq_items.answer: The bike ride from San Francisco to Sausalito is about 8 miles one way and usually takes 60–90 minutes at a relaxed touring pace. This iconic route crosses the Golden Gate Bridge and continues along a mostly downhill ride into Sausalito, making it one of the most popular routes featured on San Francisco bike tours.

faq_items.question: Is there a bike path across the Golden Gate Bridge?
faq_items.answer: Yes. The Golden Gate Bridge has dedicated bike access, with cyclists sharing one side of the bridge depending on the day and time. The path is clearly marked and well-maintained. Our Golden Gate Bridge tours provide up-to-date guidance on which side to ride and ensure a safe, stress-free crossing.
